summary.text: Robin Vanderpool is the Republican candidate for the Hawaii House of Representatives, District 13, where he faces Democratic incumbent Mahina Poepoe in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Vanderpool was also a candidate for District 13 in the November 3, 2020 general election, which Lynn DeCoite won.
